reason: My co-founder and I already run everything through WhatsApp, a shared Google Sheet and one Google Calendar, and it costs us nothing. Moving both of us into a new app means rebuilding all of that for a problem we don't really feel yet.
objection: Slack's free plan already covers our chat, and the sheet does the tasks. I can't see what $20 a month buys us that our free setup doesn't, and getting my co-founder to switch tools is a fight I don't want this week.
would_change_my_mind: If it synced both ways with our Google Calendar and imported our Google Sheet in one go, so we could try it during the free trial without moving anything by hand.
